title: Red Hat Security Advisory: libsoup security update
description: Multiple heap buffer overflow vulnerabilities were discovered in libsoup, an HTTP client and server library for GNOME, related to WebSocket handling. These include issues from WebSocket Pong signal type confusion, message reassembly, receive-buffer growth, and client-frame masking. The vulnerabilities affect Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7 Extended Lifecycle Support versions. Red Hat has issued an important security advisory with updates to address these flaws.
